decisions.title: Platform baseline: Next.js on Vercel; provider-agnostic AI adapter off by default; hosted-KV persistence behind a seam
MVP scope: forms + uploads with text extraction; JSON+Markdown report (browser-print PDF); anonymous workspace keys
Canonical stage model: three-point internal key; namespaced native stage ids; 3-label confidence vocabulary; exceptions as first-class data
Finding model: distinct safety/compliance kinds; null-safe framework-relative risk components; canonical recommendation-wording discipline; reviewer workflow
